name: Bikerranch
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Bikerranch in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser!**

Experience the thrill of riding through the breathtaking landscapes of **Tirol** with our expert-guided mountain bike tours. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced rider, our routes take you through lush forests, along crystal-clear streams, and up to stunning viewpoints with panoramic vistas of the **Kaisergebirge**.

After an adrenaline-packed day on two wheels, relax at our ranch with hearty **Tiroler** hospitality. Savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and fresh mountain trout, paired with local craft beers and **Tiroler** wines.

Stay overnight in our cozy lodges or camp under the stars in our well-equipped glamping sites. The **Wilden Kaiser** awaits—your adventure starts here!

**Book your unforgettable biking escape today!** 🚵‍♂️✨
